title: Genre and Author Diversity
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=book:finished
| stats count as books, dc(author) as authors by genre
| sort - books
description: Breaks your finished reading down by genre and author diversity, revealing your ruts and blind spots.
value: Seeing that you read one genre almost exclusively is the nudge to broaden your horizons on purpose.
implementation: Ingest finished books into `index=personal`; summarise by genre and distinct authors.
visualization: Bar chart of books finished by genre.
grandmaExplanation: It breaks your reading down by genre and author, revealing whether you should branch out more.
